name: Marvel's Spider-Man
description: An insecure but courageous and intelligent teen named Peter Parker, a new student of Midtown High, is bitten by a radioactive spider and given powers. He becomes a hero named Spider-Man after the death of his uncle and he must adapt to this new way of life.

videos.title: Origin 1
videos.overview: Peter Parker is on a field trip to Oscorp when he accidentally gets bitten by a radioactive spider.

videos.title: Origin 2
videos.overview: Peter uses science to investigate his spider bite.

videos.title: Origin 3
videos.overview: Peter begins to develop super powers.

videos.title: Origin 4
videos.overview: Peter predicts his new abilities could bring him fame.

videos.title: Origin 5
videos.overview: Peter enters a wrestling competition.

videos.title: Origin 6
videos.overview: With great power comes great responsibility.

videos.title: ZOMBIES | Meg Donnelly, Kylee Russell and Carla Jeffrey
videos.overview: "Zombies" guest stars Meg Donnelly, Kylee Russell and Carla Jeffrey discuss what it was like voicing symbiote sisters in the animated "Marvel's Spider-Man: Maximum Venom".

videos.title: The Secret History of VENOM
videos.overview: In a frightening allegory, Venom tells us his origin story – the creation of the symbiote race by the near-immortal cosmic being known as Knull, the battle his four sisters (All-Black, Scream, Scorn and Mania) fought to defend the species, and Venom’s own creation and subsequent mission on Earth.

videos.title: Planet Venom
videos.overview: We all know what Venom looks like on our friendly neighborhood Spider-Man, but what about on a squirrel? Or a rabbit? Or a wasp? Scary! Ranging from terrifying to terrifyingly cute, you will never look at a symbiote the same way again!

videos.title: Venom Files: Spider-Man
videos.overview: Spider-Man thought he knew how to defeat the Venom symbiote, but all that is about to change… Will this be Spidey’s last battle before succumbing to his mortal enemy?

videos.title: Venom Files: Captain America
videos.overview: Steve Rogers, aka Captain America, is a force of goodness, justice, and strength. But what happens when this Avenger starts wielding his shield for the bad guys?

videos.title: Venom Files: Ghost-Spider
videos.overview: Gwen Stacy (aka Ghost-Spider) is no stranger to symbiotes. As part of the Spider Team, she’s beaten Venom on multiple occasions – which is exactly why Venom wants her on his side!

videos.title: Venom Files: Miles Morales
videos.overview: Miles Morales has been helping Spider-Man protect the city from Venom for years now. But even Miles – a heroic force of innocence and good – can be turned…

videos.title: Venom Files: Doctor Strange
videos.overview: Doctor Stephen Strange is the wielder of the Eye of Agamotto and the world’s most powerful mage. That immense power is exactly what attracts Venom to transform this Sorcerer Supreme into the Symbiote Supreme!

videos.title: Venom Files: Totally Awesome Hulk
videos.overview: Amadeus Cho is the seventh smartest person in the world. He’s also the TOTALLY AWESOME HULK! But you know what’s not totally awesome? A hulking force of symbiote destruction!

videos.title: Venom Files: Iron Man
videos.overview: Tony Stark (aka Iron Man is known throughout the world for his ingenuity, heroism, and leadership. But unfortunately, it is precisely those qualities that make him the perfect target for an angry alien symbiote!

videos.title: Venom Files: Captain Marvel
videos.overview: She’s a pilot, a hero, and one of the most powerful beings in the universe. She’s Carol Danvers -- Captain Marvel! Take this powerhouse, add a little symbiote, and what do you get? One dangerous threat.

videos.title: Venom Files: Groot
videos.overview: Groot is a unique and powerful alien lifeform…and a perfect target for the terrifying Venom! No one will expect this groovy little sapling's bark to be just as bad as his bite!

videos.title: "How to Talk Like Venom" with Ben Pronsky
videos.overview: Get an in-depth look on how to sound like the villainous Venom from actor Ben Pronsky (@benpronsky), the voice of Venom himself!

videos.title: Road to Maximum Venom
videos.overview: Peter Parker breaks down everything there is to know about one of his biggest baddies ever: The Venom Symbiote! Featuring Science Sidebars, citations, and some spot-on impressions, this deep dive on Venom is essential viewing for anyone interested in the villainous alien!

videos.title: Horizon High (1)
videos.overview: Peter is accepted into Horizon High: a school for geniuses, where his best friend Harry Osborn was just suspended. Peter makes his debut as Spider-Man and must battle the Vulture.

videos.title: Horizon High (2)
videos.overview: Spider-Man must work to stop the Scorpion from wreaking havoc at the museum.

videos.title: Osborn Academy
videos.overview: Norman Osborn creates the Osborn Academy for Geniuses as a way of saving his son, Harry, the embarrassment of being suspended from Horizon High.

videos.title: A Day in the Life
videos.overview: Spider-Man must stop Black Cat from committing a spree of thefts while still keeping his school obligations.

videos.title: Party Animals
videos.overview: Horizon High throws a dance in honor of Harry being exonerated, but Norman asks Harry to stay at the Oz Academy.

videos.title: Sandman
videos.overview: Spider-Man meets the powerful, yet uncontrollable Sandman and helps him reunite with his estranged daughter with the help of the Venom symbiote.

videos.title: Symbiotic Relationship
videos.overview: When Spider-Man uses his new black costume, he discovers that there is great danger in his new power; and he must find a way to defeat a costume that wants to destroy him.

videos.title: Stark Expo
videos.overview: After the terror of the symbiote, Spidey is off to the Stark Expo in his old costume. When Ghost hijacks the event, Spidey's only chance to save lives is to unleash the symbiote.

videos.title: Ultimate Spider-Man
videos.overview: When Miles Morales is bitten by an experimental spider and gains spider powers, Spider-Man must teach him the responsibilities of being a superhero.

videos.title: Kraven's Amazing Hunt
videos.overview: Kraven the Hunter does a live broadcast of his hunt for Spider-Man.

videos.title: Halloween Moon
videos.overview: On Halloween night, Spider-Man must team up with the incredible Hulk to stop Man-Wolf, a super-strong gamma-powered werewolf, from infecting the rest of Manhattan.

videos.title: Spider-Man on Ice
videos.overview: Spidey must stop a low-level villain who has acquired some impressive freezing technology.

videos.title: Venom
videos.overview: The symbiote has escaped the Avengers Compound and attached itself to a new host. Now Spidey must find out how to beat it and who the new person is underneath.

videos.title: Screwball Live
videos.overview: Spider-Man is targeted by a new costumed figure named Screwball for a series of online prank videos which block him from fighting crime.

videos.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (1)
videos.overview: When Otto Octavius is caught in an explosion that fuses his robot arms to his body, Spider-Man sees the opportunity to recruit "The Octopus" into becoming a hero.

videos.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (2)
videos.overview: Spidey invites The Octopus to patrol the streets alongside Miles and himself until it becomes clear that Otto isn't exactly a team player.

videos.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (3)
videos.overview: Peter spends a day at Osborn Academy in the hopes of finding a clue that will convince Harry that his father is out to destroy Spider-Man.

videos.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (4)
videos.overview: Spider-Man must team up with Gwen Stacy and a reluctant Harry Osborn to investigate the truth behind the missing Raymond Warren aka the Jackal.

videos.title: Spider-Island (1)
videos.overview: Spider-Man tracks a new villain with spider powers who steals his experimental stealth suit and threatens the entire city.

videos.title: Spider-Island (2)
videos.overview: Everyone in Manhattan manifests spider powers; Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen must help Black Widow track down Crossbones before he delivers the vibranium to Arnim Zola and Hydra.

videos.title: Spider-Island (3)
videos.overview: Peter must find a way to cure Gwen Stacy and Norman Osborn after they turn into spider monsters; things get harder when Kraven the Hunter turns New York into his hunting grounds.

videos.title: Spider-Island (4)
videos.overview: Peter and Harry must battle through an island of spider monsters to get to Norman Osborn, who appears to control them all; the boys discover the real mastermind.

videos.title: Spider-Island (5)
videos.overview: To cure the spider-monster population of Manhattan, Spider-Man must lead Kid Arachnid, Anya and Harry on a desperate, last-ditch effort to stop the Jackal.

videos.title: The Hobgoblin (1)
videos.overview: Spider-Man takes on Doc Ock and his Sinister Five before they brainwash Spidey and destroy New York City.

videos.title: The Hobgoblin (2)
videos.overview: Spider-Man must find a way to stop Hobgoblin, who seems completely bent on doing whatever it takes to destroy Spider-Man.

videos.title: How I Thwipped My Summer Vacation
videos.overview: Peter Parker struggles to balance the best summer vacation ever and his responsibilities as Spider-Man.

videos.title: Take Two
videos.overview: Spider-Man is excited to start his second year as a superhero and as a student at Horizon High, but discovers that Doc Ock also claims to want a second chance.

videos.title: Between an Ock and a Hard Place
videos.overview: Spider-Man discovers there is a new Doctor Octopus taking up the mantle from Otto Octavius and finds himself drawn into this new mystery, missing the danger right under his nose.

videos.title: Rise Above It All
videos.overview: Spider-Man has to infiltrate the viral superstars known as the Wake Riders in order to figure out what the end game is with their stolen Vulture tech. But things take a dangerous turn as Adrian Toomes is tempted back to the dark side.

videos.title: School of Hard Knocks
videos.overview: Spider-Man teams up with Ms. Marvel to investigate an elite boarding school after its students start displaying out-of-control, super-powered behaviors.

videos.title: Dead Man’s Party
videos.overview: Eddie Brock, who has emerged with the vengeance-filled Venom symbiote, sets his sights on destroying Peter Parker and everything that is Spider-Man.

videos.title: Venom Returns
videos.overview: Spider-Man is two steps behind as Venom kidnaps key figures in Peter Parker's life; demanding a face-off against Peter, Venom holds them hostage at Horizon High.

videos.title: Bring on the Bad Guys (1)
videos.overview: A mystery villain puts a bounty on Spider-Man's head, bringing on attacks from Panda-Mania, Hippo and Overdrive.

videos.title: Bring on the Bad Guys (2)
videos.overview: Anya must step up and embrace being the Spider-Girl; Spider-Man is lured into Mysterio's funhouse and learns that there is a bounty on his head.

videos.title: Bring on the Bad Guys (3)
videos.overview: Spider-Man faces off against his most bizarre bad guy yet, Jack O'Lantern; he turns Prowler, a reluctant villain, to the side of heroes when he helps him save his brother.

videos.title: Bring on the Bad Guys (4)
videos.overview: Spidey tracks the identity of the mysterious boss that put a price on his head and who has been sending villains after him.

videos.title: Brain Drain
videos.overview: Spider-Man and Miles Morales discover Doc Ock, whose mind has been hiding inside the metal body of the Living Brain, has been behind the mysterious bounty for Spider-Man’s head.

videos.title: The Living Brain
videos.overview: Spider-Man must fight his way through the Super-Villain Holding Facility to challenge the Living Brain, the robot body that houses the mind of Doctor Octopus.

videos.title: The Day Without Spider-Man
videos.overview: The Bloodgem accidentally reawakens Gwen Stacy's dormant spider-powers, turning her into Ghost Spider!

videos.title: My Own Worst Enemy
videos.overview: Doc Ock intends to bring New York to its knees, but his new brain still contains memories of Uncle Ben.

videos.title: Critical Update
videos.overview: Doc Ock must adjust to his new life as a hero and is tested by rising crime boss Sand Girl.

videos.title: A Troubled Mind
videos.overview: Superior Spider-Man is confronted by the Avengers who suspect that he is not who he claims to be.

videos.title: Cloak and Dagger
videos.overview: When Cloak and Dagger emerge to take revenge against Tiberius Stone and his company, Alchemax, Superior Spider-Man must take them down to protect the school.

videos.title: Superior
videos.overview: Superior Spider-Man must face his most challenging opponent when Venom escapes from stasis and attacks Midtown High seeking revenge on Peter Parker.

videos.title: Brand New Day
videos.overview: A series of attacks captures the Avengers one-by-one. Spider-Man is left to figure out who is behind the kidnappings.

videos.title: The Cellar
videos.overview: Spider-Man takes his mission to The Cellar, where he believes The Regent is using his powers of Cloak & Dagger as well as other supervillains to hold the Avengers captive.

videos.title: The Road to Goblin War
videos.overview: Spider-Man has to take down the slick new villain, Slyde, who is stealing various chemicals from around the city in an effort to create a deadly virus that could wipe out New York.

videos.title: Goblin War (1)
videos.overview: Spider-Man must team up with Spider-Girl Ghost Spider, and Doc Ock to track down a new threat — the mysterious Goblin Nation.

videos.title: Goblin War (2)
videos.overview: As Spider-Man and Harry Osborn seek the Goblin King to determine who is behind the Goblin Mask, Spider-Man becomes concerned Harry is leading him into trap.

videos.title: Goblin War (3)
videos.overview: Peter Parker struggles with the duality of his social life at school and hiding his secret identity from everyone, including his best friend Harry Osborn

videos.title: Goblin War (4)
videos.overview: Spider-Man, Miles Morales, Spider-Girl, Ghost Spider, Harry Osborn and Doc Ock must stop the Goblin King in his newly acquired Goblin Mech Suit before he destroys New York City.

videos.title: Web of Venom
videos.overview: When Spider-Man and Max Modell experiment on a sample of Venom symbiote, it escapes and unleashes a weapon of unknown purpose.

videos.title: Amazing Friends
videos.overview: When Toddler Groot lands on Earth to deliver an urgent warning, Spider-Man must decode the message and keep him out of the evil clutches of both A.I.M. and Baron Mordo.

videos.title: Vengeance of Venom
videos.overview: Symbiotes from space send an advanced hunting party to Earth to take out all of the superheroes; Spider-Man must team up with Marc Spector and Max Modell to save the planet.

videos.title: Spider-Man Unmasked
videos.overview: After Aleksei is turned back into the rampaging Rhino by Swarm, the Spider Team must battle for their lives in the Underground Monster League contest.

videos.title: Generations
videos.overview: Spider-Man discovers Norman Osborn is responsible for the Venom Symbiote's escape; Norman, aka the Dark Goblin, brings the Generations team to battle against Spider-Man.

videos.title: Maximum Venom
videos.overview: When Spider-Man and his allies attempt to track down the missing and dangerous Lizard, they discover that Venom has returned to seek revenge on the earth.
